name: Captain Venna
source:
Once an elite cyber soldier, now a lethal and tactical supervillain, she can disable entire technological arsenals with a single electromagnetic pulse generated by her cybernetic implants. Dishonorably discharged from the army after a long series of thefts, she abandoned the military ideal to engage in daring robberies in cities. She lives day by day, driven by a mix of ingenuity, resentment, and a desire for revenge, turning every heist into a demonstration of her destructive talent.
